summary: Flat northern end of a busy hill road; homes 20 m or more away.

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwellings 22-23 m east across the verge, kindergarten 21 m; trees screen the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road; cars parked on the east kerb just south, so room at the kerb is likely but trees narrow the verge.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with buses; noise.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the east kerb from 50 to 110 m; a 10-minute school-hours sign sits near the kerb.

flags: School-hours 10 minute parking sign mapped on this kerb
Steep to the south: mean 10.5%, max 17.6%
sun_shade: Mostly shaded by tree canopy on the east side; open to the west and sky above the road.
cannot_judge: Room to pull in at the bend

best_section.where: east kerb at the top of the bend, opposite the kindergarten end
